# Fixture provenance

11 BOE disposition documents (XML), recorded 2026-11-04 from `https://www.boe.es/diario_boe/xml.php?id=<ID>`; identifiers come from the daily summary `https://www.boe.es/datosabiertos/api/boe/sumario/20261103` (BOE of 2026-11-03). Files are unmodified and each is under 13 KB.

Selection: institutional and normative documents only (job-call extracts by public bodies, a judicial-body agreement, a bilateral-commission agreement, a court summons notice). Documents that list candidates or other private individuals were excluded; the only personal names present are those of the public office-holders who sign each resolution.

Licence: reuse of information on the BOE electronic office is allowed under the Agency's standard reuse licence (Resolución de 27 de junio de 2024), published at https://www.boe.es/informacion/aviso_legal/index.php (attribution to the Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado, no alteration of meaning). Legislative texts are public domain per art. 13 of Spain's Intellectual Property Law.

IDs: BOE-A-2026-23033, BOE-A-2026-23037, BOE-A-2026-23041, BOE-A-2026-23045, BOE-A-2026-23049, BOE-A-2026-23053, BOE-A-2026-23057, BOE-A-2026-23061, BOE-A-2026-23065, BOE-A-2026-23085, BOE-A-2026-23097.
